item.title: IonQ and EPB launch quantum communications center
item.summary: IonQ and Chattanooga utility and communications provider EPB are establishing the Tennessee Quantum Communications Research Center, a new laboratory designed to test quantum networking technology on a live fiber-optic network. The partners say the facility will become the first dedicated quantum communications R&D center to connect directly to an operational network.
